stem: Batch X reports 90% rooting at day 14 and Batch Y reports 78% at day 7. Why is a direct performance ranking weak?
choices: The larger percentage always proves the better process.
The observation time differs, so the outcomes are not yet comparable at the same endpoint.
Day of observation never affects propagation performance.
rationale: The observation time differs, so the outcomes are not yet comparable at the same endpoint.
